definitions.gloss: Indian summer; a period of warm, calm weather in late autumn
definitions.explanation: unseasonably warm and pleasant weather occurring in late autumn (November-December in Japan), reminiscent of early spring

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小春日和|こはるびより}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: Today we have Indian summer weather and it's warm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{十一月|じゅういちがつ}→十一月：00635_juuichigatsu⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小春日和|こはるびより}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Even though it's November, the Indian summer continues.

examples.japanese: {小春日和|こはるびより}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧な⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧、⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: On a calm Indian summer afternoon, I enjoyed reading in the park.

notes:
FORMS:
{小春|こはる} (early winter, the 10th month in the lunar calendar) + {日和|びより} (fine weather) → fine weather of early winter

SEASON:
Despite containing ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧ (spring), {小春|こはる} refers to the 10th month of the lunar calendar, which corresponds to November in the modern calendar. The name comes from the spring-like warmth.

CHARACTERISTICS:
- ⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧な⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧ (calm weather)
- ⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{陽気|ようき}→陽気：03657_youki⟧ (warm climate)
- ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (windless days)

NOTE ON {日和|びより}:
{日和|びより} (fine weather for something) is used in many compound words:
- {行楽日和|こうらくびより} (perfect weather for an outing)
- {洗濯日和|せんたくびより} (perfect laundry-drying weather)
- {花見日和|はなみびより} (perfect cherry blossom viewing weather)
